fb.title: Feedback
fb.menu: Report a bug or an idea
fb.lead: Found a bug, have an idea, or want to work together? Andrii reads every message.
fb.kind.label: What is it about?
fb.bug.placeholder: What you did, what you expected, what happened instead
fb.idea.placeholder: What would make the simulator better for you?
fb.contact.label: Contact (optional)
fb.contact.placeholder: Email, Telegram, anything — only if you want an answer
fb.diag.consent: Attach technical details to help fix it
fb.diag.what: Only with this box ticked, the report also carries:
fb.diag.browser: browser, GPU, screen size and frame rate
fb.diag.scene: the scene's id, version and size (scale)
fb.diag.walls: the walls and voxel grid settings
fb.diag.log: the flight log of your current life, to replay what happened
fb.diag.picture: also a small picture of the current view
fb.diag.none: Nothing else: no cookies, no files, no personal data.
fb.done.title: Thank you — it's in.
fb.done.id: Your report number: {id}. Mention it if you write again.
fb.error: Sending didn't work this time. Your text is still here — please try again in a moment.
